title: Boone County enacted ordinances — 2026 zoning rewrite authority check

narrowZoningTextAmendments.scope: Commercial parking; freight container; freight terminal; semitrailer; trailer; truck; truck tractor, with identified zoning-district changes.
Manufactured home; qualified manufactured home; mobile home definitions and identified zoning-district changes.

ordinanceDatabase.sourceGap: The county-linked American Legal ordinance database returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge on both direct and browser-style/referrer retrieval attempts. The denial page was not archived as ordinance content.

authorityFinding: The county Enacted Ordinances page, retrieved on 2026-10-03, lists 2026 enacted ordinances through Ordinance 2026-15 dated September 23, 2026. Among the parsed 2026 entries, no description identifies adoption of the 2026 comprehensive zoning ordinance rewrite, Article 34 replacement, or sign-regulation rewrite. Ordinances 2026-02 and 2026-03 are real zoning text amendments but are narrowly scoped and must not be mistaken for the comprehensive rewrite.
authorityBoundary: This establishes what appears on the official Boone County Enacted Ordinances page as retrieved on 2026-10-03. It does not prove that no unposted enactment exists, does not establish action by other legislative bodies in the Boone County Planning Unit, and does not substitute for a later effective-date or adoption record if one is posted.
adoptedSignAuthority: Continue using the separately archived adopted Boone County Zoning Regulations Article 34 as sign-regulation authority for the Boone County jurisdiction unless newer reviewed official enactment/effective-date evidence establishes replacement text.
nextLogicalAuthorityTarget: After October 6, recheck Fiscal Court action/minutes and the Enacted Ordinances page for any newly posted rewrite ordinance; separately identify the other Boone County Planning Unit legislative bodies that would need adoption evidence before treating the rewrite as universally effective.
